name: hem
description: Root task runner. Holds no dependencies, so there is no node_modules here.

scripts.test: pnpm -C frontend test && uv run --directory backend pytest
scripts.verify: pnpm check:tokens && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.baseline: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/w -w /w/frontend mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.e2e:docker: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/w -w /w/frontend mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx playwright test
